summary: Capstone Holding Corp. filed an 8-K to report routine amendments to subsidiary credit agreements with Berkshire Bank (extending maturity to Dec 31, 2026) and Stream Finance (extending maturity to Sep 30, 2028). The filing also notes the 2026 annual meeting of stockholders occurred, but provides no voting results. These are ordinary-course financing modifications and a procedural meeting disclosure; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist campaign is present. Therefore, this does not constitute a special situation.
